status: Teacher-supplied materials are the primary source. Public sources were consulted through web search only (search result summaries); the agency pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so the 'confirmed' entries below are marked as such and every entry says what still needs a human look.
note: This file is public, so it lists topics and statuses, not which answer option is correct in any question.

sources.name: CDC/NCHS Data Brief 565, Leading Mechanisms of Unintentional Injury Death Among Youth Ages 10-19, United States, 2024
NHTSA, Seat Belt Use in 2025 (DOT HS 813 799)

AHA 2020 pediatric basic life support guidance (infant compressions with two fingers, about one third of chest depth; C-A-B retained)
AAP/AHA 2024 update on resuscitation after drowning: CPR with rescue breaths, started before the AED is applied
